notes.title: Update build 1.0.0.5

tags.feature: [*] Added new animations for some abilities;
[*] Designed new UI;
[*] Extended item categories and subcategories for Storyteller Mode;
[*] Increased to 50 (later more) items to build your location;
[*] A goblums is available, on which it will be more interesting to practice new animations of abilities;
[*] In Storyteller Mode, it is now possible to create custom worlds and maps for them;
[*] Your own map in Storyteller Mode can now be saved (for now, all players can see the maps you saved);

[*] Storyteller Mode has been radically changed for testing, now you can try to build a small town with goblums, go to the built map as a player, and solve, in the language of pain, all the burning questions with goblums.

tags.bug: [*] Fixed not being able to apply settings while playing characters;
[*] Controlling the character has become more convenient, and errors with Shift have been fixed.

notes.title: Update build 1.0.0.4

tags.feature: [*] ESC is now invoked in Storyteller Mode and also disables ESC in-game menus and game settings when pressed again;
[*] Added loading screen;
[*] Added Ukrainian localization;
[*] The main menu again displays the current version of the game, and also added a link to the official site and Discord server;
[*] Added target;
[*] Added d20, which temporarily activates on "Y" and is a visual add-on;
[*] Added a dot in the center of the screen.

tags.bug: [*] When playing as a female character and pressing RMB, the game no longer throws an error;
[*] The camera no longer changes position when a character is sneaking;
[*] The "Apply" button in the game settings now works correctly.

notes.title: Update build 1.0.0.3

tags.feature: Redesigned main menu;
The lighting of the bazaar has been reworked;
Character movement has been redesigned;
Changed the control of the character;
Changed the ability activation interface to a radial menu.
Added low-functionality Storyteller Mode (StM);
Added Esc menu;
Added Settings: ambient volume, music volume, mouse sensitivity;
Added several types of costume colors for the character.
Removed the crafting menu for a complete rethinking.

tags.bug: The tutorial no longer appears after setting up a camp;
The cursor will no longer appear after hovering over the button;
Moving items via E now works correctly.
